items.raw_excerpt: A recent heat wave has forced tenants to find ways to survive the high temperatures. Some believe the government should limit allowable indoor temperatures for rental units and offer financial aids for cooling methods.

items.raw_excerpt: When Patrícia Maciel arrived in Braga in 2002, the School of Medicine at the University of Minho was still finding its feet, and the research institute being built alongside it had no real precedent in Portugal. She came to teach biochemistry, but what she ended up helping to build would change what a research institute could look like in this country.

items.raw_excerpt: A mostra convida o público a conhecer a história de um território marcado pela chegada de africanos escravizados, mas também pela resistência, pela produção cultural e pela formação da identidade brasileira.
items.summary_en: A museum in Rio de Janeiro is showing an exhibition about Little Africa. This area was marked by the arrival of enslaved Africans, but also by resistance and cultural life. The show invites visitors to learn how this history helped build Brazilian identity.

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwanese artists and curators on Saturday issued a joint statement protesting what they called the "political censorship" of the Taiwan Pavilion by the Gwangju Biennale, which removed "Taiwan" from its promotional materials and replaced it with NTMoFA, the abbreviation for the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts.
items.summary_en: The Gwangju Biennale took the word 'Taiwan' out of its materials. It now uses the short name of the National Taiwan Museum of Fine Arts instead. Taiwanese artists and curators said this is political censorship.
